private_key_policy: Private signing keys are never stored in the repository. Local releases use a repository-external key; CI uses a protected secret.
rotation_policy: Add and distribute the successor public key before use, certify one overlap release, then mark the predecessor revoked after the overlap release is independently verified.
revocation_policy: Add the fingerprint to revoked_fingerprints, publish a signed revocation notice with the unaffected successor identity, revoke every affected release, and never rewrite historical certificates.
